scope_now: null policy and common-scope preflight only; no model construction/fit/optimizer/PT scores
proxy: observed SIDER record; unknown NOT verified negative; not clinical risk

threshold.sensitivity_status: deferred; not part of first WP09 primary fit request
threshold.reason: user-retained topology/null-feasibility proposal; not predictive optimization

architecture.head: single linear train-PT logits
architecture.message: z=relu(Px); h=z+relu(Sz+M mean_neighbor(z)); empty neighbors mean zero

loss.name: BCEWithLogitsLoss
loss.reduction: mean over valid train targets per eligible drug, then mean drugs

epochs.restore: best inner validation epoch; ties earliest
epochs.outer_refit_epochs: floor(median(selected epochs on common valid inner folds)+0.5), separately per variant/null replicate; never outer-test early-stop

selection.fewer_valid_folds: entire outer primary comparison NA_selection_insufficient, all three variants; no fit/fallback to rescue
selection.candidate_target_scope: frozen B2 train dictionary and shared train-fittable mask; same within each inner fold
selection.common_inner_set: intersection of topology-valid folds (all 3 nulls OK) and finite/evaluable validation folds for all 5 fits (noPPI, realPPI, 3 shuffled)
selection.skipped_inner_folds: all variants excluded together from primary selection/epoch summary; frozen split membership unchanged
selection.metric_NA_rule: exclude only undefined/nonfinite or failed fit, never low metric; support/NA logged
selection.shuffle_summary: metrics per fixed null replica plus equal mean of three metrics; no averaging PT predictions; no best replica

PPI_universe: only train-linked validated sequence accessions; strict human induced PPI
query: unseen sequence accession self-only; no query-to-train messages; missing all modalities abstain

shuffle.candidate_acceptance: 10*E accepted swaps within 200*E attempts AND removed_original_edges/E >=0.5

evaluation: not executed; same frozen primary/stress split; exact paired54/NA scope, own61 separate
uncertainty: future fixed OOF structural-group paired bootstrap, conditional; not external validation
open_gate: explicit training approval of v3 including missing-null/common-fold policy; no remaining automatic choices
revision_basis: Preserve generator/seeds/0.5 criterion; specify three fixed null replicates and shared inner/outer NA rules before new preflight outcomes

null_failure_policy.inner: Any failed null replica -> that inner fold excluded for ALL variants/replicas from primary comparison; raw failure NA retained
null_failure_policy.outer: Any failed final null replica -> entire outer primary triad comparison NA_null_outer; no replacement by real/noPPI
null_failure_policy.numerical_or_metric_failure: apply same common-fold rule after inner validation; no score-based fold selection
null_failure_policy.cohort: keep 62 IDs and reasons; report missing outer coverage, never call incomplete result full 5-fold/all62 performance
null_failure_policy.old_failed_null: old rep0 remains NA; rep1/rep2 never replace it
